events.verdict: Ingram (TOR) initiates illegal contact to Gordon's (DEN) body during his shot attempt at the basket.
Jokic (DEN) and Poeltl (TOR) mutually engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
After Jokic (DEN) secures the rebound, Barnes (TOR) initiates illegal contact with Jokic's face and affects his SQBR.
Murray (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Barnes' (TOR) path and absorbs the incidental contact as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) legally contests Barnes' (TOR) shot attempt at the basket.
Gordon (DEN) establishes himself in Barnes' (TOR) path prior to the contact.
Poeltl (TOR) legally contests Murray's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Ingram (TOR) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge the rebound from Braun (DEN) as he attempts to secure it.
Jokic (DEN) initiates illegal contact with Poeltl's (TOR) head during the layup attempt.
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in Barrett's (TOR) path prior to the contact.
Jokic (DEN) turns and brings his arms down during the post move, creating marginal contact between his body and Barrett's (TOR) outstretched arm as Barrett defends the shot attempt.
Murray (DEN) establishes himself in Barnes' (TOR) path, and incidental contact occurs when Barnes inadvertently steps on Murray's planted foot as they converge at the same spot on the perimeter.
Jokic (DEN) is actively guarding an opponent within three seconds of entering the lane.

Gordon (DEN) absorbs the marginal contact from Barnes (TOR) as he comes to a stop at the end of the drive. Gordon firms up on his right foot and brings his right arm into a vertical position, absorbing the contact initiated by Barnes as he extends into him during the shot attempt. Subsequently, Gordon cleanly blocks the shot attempt.
Poeltl (TOR) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.

Barnes (TOR) grabs and pulls Murray's (DEN) jersey away from his body, affecting his SQBR. The illegal contact occurs prior to the upward shooting motion, therefore, a non-shooting foul is correctly assessed. As Denver is in the bonus, two free throw attempts are awarded.
Jokic (DEN) commits a take foul on Poeltl (TOR).
Barrett (TOR) brings his hand toward the ball and marginal contact occurs with Gordon's (DEN) arm as he secures the rebound.

Barrett (TOR) grabs and holds Murray's (DEN) arm, affecting his FOM during the inbound. The contact occurs prior to the throw-in, therefore, an away from the play foul is correctly assessed. Although the foul is reported on Barrett, it is attributed to Poeltl (TOR) in the play-by-play.
Barrett (TOR) commits a take foul on Gordon (DEN).
Barnes (TOR) extends his upper body toward Gordon (DEN) during the screen, and the contact is marginal.
Gordon (DEN) legally contests Ingram's (TOR) jump shot attempt.

Jokic (DEN) brings his hand toward the ball and marginal follow-through contact occurs with Barnes' (TOR) arm and face after he tips the loose ball away. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Ingram (TOR) steps on the sideline out of bounds prior to elevating in an attempt to save the ball from going out. Possession is correctly awarded to the Nuggets.
